proof_basis: exact degree-one and degree-two root factorization

scientific_limitations: The sharp numeric inequality 5p-4 is due to Krahmer, Pfander and Rashkov (2006/2008); only complete equality geometry and coefficient classification are asserted as the new result.
The classification applies only to prime cyclic groups of order at least seven and exactly three nonzero values in each independent signal/window.
Historical priority is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent equality classifications. No near-extremizer stability or composite-order claim is made.
Finite tests complement, but do not prove, the universal analytic conclusion.
title: Complete equality fibers for three-sparse prime-cyclic cross-STFT uncertainty
